fixture.abdul/trac.analysis:
Hi Abdul,

I went through the VPN client log you sent and the failure is not on the server side.
The client was configured with the wrong gateway address: the site entry points at 85.154.31.42, which is
not the address of the company gateway. Every connection attempt therefore goes to a host that never
completes the authentication handshake, and the client gives up after the first step.

What I checked:
- the profile of the site in the client settings (gateway field);
- the DNS name of the gateway against the address in the profile;
- the time of the first failed attempt.

What I recommend:
1. Open the site's entry in the client and correct the gateway address.
2. Save the entry and disconnect any half-open session.
3. Connect again and watch the first handshake.
4. If it still fails, send me the new log and I will look again.

I recommend doing this before touching the certificate or the account, because a wrong gateway explains
all the symptoms by itself. The same wrong gateway entry may be present on the other laptops of the
team, so please fix the site's gateway entry there too, and tell me if anyone cannot reach the address.

Best regards,
The network desk

Note for the ticket: the gateway entry is the only change needed.
